name: devtools
description: Guided workflows for developers building apps and integrations on the Meta Social Technologies Developer Platform (developers.facebook.com): settings, webhooks, compliance, app review, API health, and WhatsApp Max Price setup. Developer Platform workflows use Meta Social Technologies MCP. WhatsApp Business integration also needs WhatsApp Business Tools MCP (https://mcp.facebook.com/whatsapp_business_tools); whatsapp-business-marketing-messages-max-price-setup uses only that WhatsApp server.
